function: Joint UAV horizontal placement and transmit-power/hybrid MRT-ZF beamforming design maximizing the energy efficiency of a UAV downlink to ground users (p. 1-2).
system: One UAV with Nx x Ny UPA (2x3 to 2x7 antennas) serving K=3-7 single-antenna ground users (MU-MISO), altitude 100 m, 2.4 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: Two-stage GNN with residual multi-head graph attention layers; first stage outputs UAV coordinate, second power and hybrid MRT/ZF coefficient; unsupervised training with EE loss (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom LoS channel with UPA steering vector and free-space path loss, Eq. (1)-(2); synthetic samples, GUs random in 40x40 m2; 8,000 training samples per set (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Train on one (NT,K) setting; test also on unseen antenna counts and user numbers, e.g. train K=6, 3x4, test K=5, 7 and 2x5, 2x7 (Table I, p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: SCA-based algorithm and exhaustive search (Fig. 3, p. 4-5); learned: MLP extended from [24] (Table I, p. 5); ablations in Tables II-III.
metrics: Energy efficiency [bit/Hz/J]; inference time in ms (Tables I-III, p. 5).
complexity: Order of complexity O(...) of RGAL, pooling and FC layers, Eq. (26) (p. 4); inference time 0.46 ms versus hours for exhaustive search (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel model follows (2)." Eq. (1)-(2), p. 2, is a custom LoS steering-vector model with free-space path loss; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "scalable to both numbers of UAV antennas and GUs which are unseen in the training set"; Table I tests K and NT different from those of training.
q3_support: p. 5: "the GNN-based model outperforms the MLP in terms of the EE" (MLP extended from [24], Table I); p. 4: "the maximum EE of each position is calculated by an SCA-based algorithm" (non-learned reference, Fig. 3).
q4_support: p. 4: "the overall computational complexity of the proposed model is on the order of" Eq. (26); p. 5: Table I gives an inference time of 0.46 ms.
q5_support: p. 4: "each training set includes 8,000 unlabeled samples", synthetic data generated by the authors; no code or data link or availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included: UAV placement alone is above the physical layer, but the GNN learns it jointly with transmit power and hybrid MRT/ZF coefficient (beamforming), so above_phy passes; area 6 (aerial-link power and beam control) wins over area 3. q3 is borderline: the non-learned comparison is one illustrative example against SCA and exhaustive search in Fig. 3 (EE map, runtime), with no table of SCA EE values; the learned baseline is the MLP of Table I.
